Local fork main branch (31 commits ahead of origin/main) carries a very large, separately-developed body of Modal/Bimodal metatheory (Metalogic completeness/soundness/conservative-extension for the full modal cube, Tableau method, ProofSystem instances) far beyond task 475's scope -- this must not be conflated with or pulled into #648/#662 stacking work.

CslibTests/GrindLint.lean is a library-wide grind run-away-instantiation gate; new @[scoped grind]/@[scoped grind =] lemmas can trip it. The file documents `#grind_lint skip <name>` as the sanctioned minimal-use escape hatch (preferred fix is grind_pattern side conditions, but skip is an accepted existing pattern, e.g. for Cslib.Logic.HML).
